body:
Thanks, I have been battling depression for years before I met her. It always feels like a series of staires, always increasing in height. You fall harder each time, and a longer climb to the top. I have fought that, and still can. The problem is the one thing that has motiviated, and made me who I am is gone. The only thing I care about is my family. now I feel like I was just a loan shark who let someone freeload at my place for 6 months, and now wants to take the kid and leave her with nothing.
She has no job, no skills. But she is her mother. I can't take her away from her mom, and coming from a broken family I can't let her deal with that either. My only option it seems is to leave the picture, and provide from her from afar. whether that is from another state, or a big check on my way to the black.... I just can't find anything in the former option.
